'''2016 European Championship Day 2 Floris de Vries DS Death Star II: Throne Room''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Floris de Vries]] at [[2016 European Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Floris de Vries]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star II: Throne Room|DS2-D-deathstariithroneroom.gif}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|According To My Design|V1-D-accordingtomydesign.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125837/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-european-championships.html Internet Archive]
